info.name: fundi-api
info.description: Postman requests for Fundi API. For job-owner requests, a customer or technician may use their access token. Public technician registration can create a user/profile; signed-in customers can also become technicians through profile completion. Uploads use form-data; admin authentication uses cookies.

request.description: Customers are created immediately without an OTP. Set role to TECHNICIAN to start phone verification; verify the OTP before profile completion.
Verify the registration OTP at /api/v1/auth/verify-otp before completing the technician profile.
Use the OTP sent during technician registration. Successful verification sets phoneVerifiedAt and returns session tokens.

request.description: Stores the returned access token in customerToken or technicianToken, based on user.role. Successful sign-in revokes the previous session. X-Device-Id is an optional stable app-install identifier.

item.name: Preview matches from geocoded place names

request.description: Geocodes up to five place names using the configured provider and returns distance-aware matches. Nominatim is the default provider.

item.name: Preview matches by technician location text

request.description: Matches by stored technician address/location labels, optional latitude/longitude coordinates, or both. Text matching includes technicians without coordinates; coordinate matches include distance.
Save response.id as paymentId. requestType defaults to NORMAL and charges visitFee; use SOS to charge sosBookingFee. Payments are valid for seven days.
Development/test only. Does not verify money with a provider and is disabled in production. Save response.id as paymentId.

item.name: Request phone OTP for this job

request.description: Optionally provide phoneNumber to verify a new customer login number. Customers with a verified current number receive verified: true and do not need another OTP; technicians still verify each job.

item.name: Verify phone OTP for this job

request.description: Use Body > form-data. First complete mock payment. Include phoneVerificationId for a technician or an unverified customer; omit it for a customer whose account phone is already verified. Add paymentId, serviceCategoryId, description, locationAddress, latitude, longitude, offeredAmount, and optional priority as text fields. Use photos (up to five) and video (one) as optional File fields.

formdata.value: Repair a leaking kitchen tap and check the connection.

item.name: Create SOS job with automatic matching

request.description: Use Body > form-data after creating an SOS payment. Include phoneVerificationId for a technician or an unverified customer; omit it for a customer whose account phone is already verified. The system offers to one approved, online matching technician at a time.

formdata.value: Urgent water leak is flooding the kitchen.

request.description: Customer confirms agreement to work with the assigned technician. The booking payment expires when the technician also confirms.
Hides a completed or cancelled job from the customer history only; this does not permanently delete it.

Use Body > form-data. Add photos as File fields and/or one video File field.

Select an actual file in Postman before sending this request.

days must be from 1 to 30. Completed payments cannot be extended.

item.name: List jobs at a pipeline stage (admin)

request.description: One page of admin job objects at a stage: request, match, accept, visit, diagnose, quote, approve, repair, settle, or rate. Untracked stages return an empty page.
Requires an admin session cookie retained by Postman, or set an admin bearer token in Authorization.
Set decision to APPROVE or REJECT. Approval releases the technician and resumes remaining payment validity.
Only completed or cancelled jobs can be permanently deleted. Payment and audit history are retained.

item.name: Job Chat - Member
item.description: Use a customer or technician bearer token that participates in the room. A room is created when a technician accepts a job assignment.

item.name: Send image, file, voice note, or video

request.description: Use Body > form-data: type=IMAGE (or FILE, VOICE_NOTE, VIDEO) as Text, file as File, and optional durationSeconds for a voice note. Limits: image 10 MiB, document 20 MiB, voice 20 MiB/5 min, video 50 MiB/60 seconds.
